worked_solution:
Using the formula for the scalar projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{q}\,p & =|\,p\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =8cos\,(\frac{\pi }{6}) \\  & =8\cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \\  & =4\sqrt{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
